title: Tidung Planet SuperDove standard Hedley processing
atmospheric_correction: Planet Surface Reflectance (6S); ACOLITE was not rerun
mask: UDM2 clear and finite in all eight bands; fixed land excluded using the four-date 25th-percentile 866 nm (>0.08) and median NDVI (>0.02). Bright glinted water is retained rather than rejected by a per-date NIR threshold.
reference: Hedley JD, Harborne AR, Mumby PJ (2005), DOI 10.1080/01431160500034086
